player_prompt.intro: Udlala iBlackjack nomthengisi. Umgomo wakho ukusondela ku-21 ngangokunokwenzeka ngaphandle kokudlula. Ngesikhathi sakho, khetha u-'[Hit]' ukudweba elinye ikhadi noma u-'[Stand]' ukubamba. J/Q/K = amaphuzu ayi-10; A = 11 noma 1, noma yikuphi okungcono.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Isenzo esingekho emthethweni. Sebenzisa u-"[Hit]" noma u-"[Stand]".
